sentences.text: This extinct animal is a parrot related to the kākāpō.
Its genus, Strigops, belongs to the family Strigopidae.
The species was formally named by Worthy et al. in 2026.
Fossils were found in New Zealand, with the specific name referring to the holotype being located on the North Island.
The species lived during the Pleistocene epoch in Zealandia during the Calabrian stage.
The genus Strigops existed from the Late Pleistocene to the Holocene, between 0.129 and 0 million years ago.
